= Create an Account and Deploy Your Free Tier Operational Cluster
:page-component-name: cloud
:page-capella-type: Operational
:description: Create an account and start managing your data with Couchbase Capella.
:page-aliases: create-app-services-account.adoc, get-started.adoc, own-account.adoc, azure-cloud:azure-cloud-connection-prerequisites.adoc, deploy-first-cluster.adoc, configure-cluster-access.adoc, tutorials:create-couchbase-cluster.adoc
:page-topic-type: tutorial
:page-pagination: next

[abstract]
{description}

To get started with Couchbase Capella, create an account and use it to deploy a forever free tier operational cluster.
This account provides you with an environment where you can explore and learn about Capella with no time constraint.

With a perpetual offering, you have the freedom to work with your active free tier operational cluster at your own pace and try out the Couchbase Capella software.

With an active and working free tier operational cluster, there is no pressure of expiration dates or incurring additional costs.

NOTE: You cannot deploy a free tier cluster in Operational Insights.
This free tier offering is only available in Capella Operational.

[#sign-up-free-tier]
== Create an Account

To create an account, go to the https://cloud.couchbase.com/sign-up[Couchbase Capella Sign-up page] and choose one of the following sign-up options:

[{tabs}]
====
Email Address::
+
--
.Procedure
. Enter the following information:
** Your *Full Name*
** Your *Email Address*
** A *Password* that contains:
+
* At least 12 characters
* Uppercase characters (A-Z)
* Lowercase characters (a-z)
* Numbers (0-9)
* Special characters, such as @, #, or $
+
. Click btn:[Get Started]. Couchbase sends an email to the email address you provided with a confirmation code for your account.
. Enter the confirmation code into the provided field.
. Review and agree to the https://www.couchbase.com/capella-terms[Terms of Service^] and the https://www.couchbase.com/privacy-policy[Privacy Policy^].
. (Optional) Subscribe to offers, products, and services from Couchbase.
. Click btn:[Create Account].

--

GitHub Account::
+
--
.Prerequisites
* In GitHub, make sure that your primary email address is https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-email-preferences/verifying-your-email-address[verified].
* In GitHub, make sure your primary email address is public.
+
To set a public GitHub email address:

. Log into GitHub, and on your profile menu, click btn:[Settings].
+
Your Public profile page should display.

. In the navigation pane, click *Emails*.

. Clear *Keep my email addresses private*.

. Return to the *Public Profile* page and select your primary email address from the *Public email* list.

.. Click btn:[Update profile] to save the changes.

.Procedure
. Click btn:[GitHub].
. Follow the GitHub prompts to sign in to your GitHub account.
. Review and agree to the https://www.couchbase.com/capella-terms[Terms of Service^] and the https://www.couchbase.com/privacy-policy[Privacy Policy^].
. (Optional) Subscribe to offers, products, and services from Couchbase.
. Click btn:[Create Account].

--

Google Account::
+
--
.Prerequisites
* If your Google account uses a non-Google email, make sure that your account is https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/63950?sjid=12585803331733388295-NA[verified].

.Procedure
. Click btn:[Google].
. Follow the Google prompts to sign in to your Google Account.
. Review and agree to the https://www.couchbase.com/capella-terms[Terms of Service^] and the https://www.couchbase.com/privacy-policy[Privacy Policy^].
. (Optional) Subscribe to offers, products, and services from Couchbase.
. Click btn:[Create Account].
--
====


[NOTE]
====
For 30-day Capella free trial users:

* If your free trial account has not yet expired, your account is automatically converted to the free tier plan after your 30-day trial period if over.
To deploy a free tier operational cluster, go to menu:Operational[] and xref:create-account.adoc#getting-started[create and deploy your free tier operational cluster].
* If your free trial account has already expired, log in to your account and click btn:[Activate Free Tier].
Proceed to deploy a free tier operational cluster or xref:create-account.adoc#upgrade-to-paid-account[upgrade to a paid plan] to continue using Capella operational.
====

== Choose Your Setup Method

Couchbase Capella offers two ways to deploy your free tier operational cluster:

. <<guided-setup,Guided Setup>> - Recommended for new users with step-by-step guidance and sample data.
. <<getting-started,Getting Started>> - For users who prefer to configure settings manually.


[#guided-setup]
== Get Started with Guided Setup

If you're new to Capella and want to see how operational clusters work with App Services, Capella provides an interactive guided setup that provisions both infrastructure types with sample data.

The guided setup creates:

* A free tier operational cluster with sample data.
* App Services infrastructure.
* A working demonstration of both services integrated together.

Follow the guided setup:

. Go to menu:App Services[].
. Click btn:[Start Guided Setup].
. Click btn:[Create Free Tier Operational Cluster] to deploy a cluster.
. Select *Import sample data* into the cluster.
. Click btn:[Create App Service] to proceed to the App Services page.
In the btn:[Create App Services] page:
. Add an *App Service User Name* and *App Endpoint Name*.
. In the *App User Credentials* section, enter a username and password for the App Service.
. Click btn:[Create App Service].
On the *Guided Setup* page, click btn:[Connect] to finish your setup.

After completing the guided setup, you can connect your App Endpoint to your application.
For more information about connecting mobile applications, see xref:get-started:configuring-app-services.adoc#access-endpoint[Connect App Services Endpoint].

NOTE: The guided setup creates a cluster with pre-configured travel-sample data and optimized settings for new users.
If you prefer to set up a cluster manually or import your own data, see <<getting-started,Create and Deploy Your Free Tier Operational cluster>>.


[#getting-started]
== Create and Deploy Your Free Tier Operational cluster

After you create your account, Couchbase creates your organization and sets a default project labeled *My First Project*.

NOTE: Only 1 free tier operational cluster is available per organization and it automatically turns off after 72 hours of inactivity.
For more information, see xref:create-account.adoc#turn-cluster-on-off[Turn Operational Cluster On and Off].

Create and deploy your first operational cluster:

. Click btn:[Create Cluster].
. Select *My First Project* as the project for your cluster.
. Under *Cluster Option*, select btn:[Free].
. In the *Name* field, enter a name for your cluster or accept the default option.
. (Optional) Provide a description of your cluster.
. Select one of the available cloud service providers:
* xref:reference:aws.adoc[AWS]
* xref:reference:gcp.adoc[Google Cloud]
* xref:reference:azure.adoc[Azure]
. Select an available geographic region for your cluster.
. Enter a *CIDR Block* for your cluster, or accept the default.
For more information about how to configure a CIDR block, see xref:clusters:databases.adoc#cloud-provider[Cloud Service Provider, Region, and CIDR Block].
. Click btn:[Create Cluster] to deploy your free tier operational cluster with Capella.

NOTE: Accounts with a paid plan can deploy a free tier operational cluster alongside their paid operational clusters.

[#turn-cluster-on-off]
=== Turn Your Operational Cluster On and Off

If there's no activity in your free tier operational cluster for more than 72 hours, Couchbase turns off the cluster and any linked App Services.
This removes the cluster's compute resources, but preserves it's data and state.
This also removes any linked App Service nodes and associated infrastructure, but preserves the state.

You can also turn off your free tier operational cluster using the UI:

. In the *Operational* tab, find your free tier cluster:

.. Click btn:[︙].

.. Click btn:[Turn Off]

. Confirm the cluster turn off request:

.. In the confirmation field, type `yes`.

.. Click btn:[Yes, Proceed] to turn off your cluster.


To turn your free tier operational cluster back on, go to menu:Operational[Home] and click btn:[Turn On Cluster].

When you resume activity in your operational cluster, any linked App Services are also turned back on.
If you're unable to resume activity in your cluster, https://www.couchbase.com/contact/[contact Couchbase support^].

To create or turn on an operational cluster, you must have the xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner] or xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-project-creator[Project Creator] role.

=== Monitor Your Free Tier Operational Cluster

You can monitor your free tier operational cluster in Capella using the built-in Monitoring Dashboards. 
These tools help you identify performance issues and analyze runtime outliers.
You can adjust the metric timeframes and resolutions according to your monitoring needs. 

To view your monitoring dashboards, go to *Monitoring* and select 1 of the dashboards:

* Cluster Overview 
* Workload Monitoring
** Data Service
** Index Service
** Query Service
** Node Overview
* Metrics Explorer

For more information, see xref:clusters:monitoring/metrics-dashboard.adoc[]. 

NOTE: The Health Advisor dashboard is not available for free tier operational clusters. 
xref:billing:upgrade-account.adoc[Upgrade] to a *Developer Pro or Enterprise plan to get expert advice on your cluster.

=== Delete Your Free Tier Operational Cluster

If there's no activity in your free tier operational cluster for more than 30 days, Couchbase deletes the operational cluster and any linked App Services.
Couchbase sends periodic emails after 72 hours of inactivity warning you that your free tier cluster is turned off and will delete after 30 days.

To recreate your free tier operational cluster, see xref:create-account.adoc#getting-started[create and deploy your free tier operational cluster].


[#app-services]
== Deploy Capella Free Tier App Services

You can use Capella App Services to:

* Sync your data between Capella operational buckets and mobile or edge devices running xref:couchbase-lite:ROOT:index.adoc[Couchbase Lite].
* Authenticate and manage mobile and edge users

To deploy free tier App Services for mobile development:

. In the *App Services* tab, click btn:[Create App Service].
. Enter a name for your App Service.
. Select your free tier operational cluster to link to your App Service.
. Click btn:[Create App Service].

[NOTE]
====
Your free tier App Service automatically links to your free tier operational cluster.
====

For more information about how to configure App Services, see xref:get-started:configuring-app-services.adoc[].

[#upgrade-to-paid-account]
== Upgrade to a Paid Account

You need to xref:billing:upgrade-account.adoc#add-activation-id[add an activation ID] to upgrade to a paid Support plan and gain access to all the Capella operational features.
For more information about the available Support Plans for Couchbase Capella, see xref:billing:billing.adoc#paid-plan[About Cluster and Service Support Plans].

Free tier operational clusters do not automatically migrate to paid operational clusters after an the upgrade.
Capella allows only one free tier operational cluster per organization at any time.

WARNING: When upgrading from a free tier plan to a paid Support plan, Couchbase deletes your existing free tier operational cluster.

When you upgrade to a paid Support plan, you can choose to deploy another free tier operational cluster alongside your provisioned operational cluster.
To back up and transfer your data from your existing free tier operational cluster to a new free tier or paid operational cluster, you must use the `cbbackupmgr` tool.

For more information about using the `cbbackupmgr` tool, see xref:clusters:cli-backup-restore.adoc#backup-free-cluster[Backup a Free Tier Capella Operational Cluster].


== Free Tier Plan Features

For more information, use the Capella UI to learn more about the free tier features and compare to other Couchbase Capella plans:

. In the *Operational* tab, choose your operational cluster to go to your cluster's page.
. Click the *Settings* tab.
. In the navigation menu, click btn:[Plan].
. Select, compare and review your Couchbase Capella plan.
